1. Bubble sort swaps adjacent out-of-order pairs; 3 moves right twice.
2. Selection sort finds the minimum 1 and swaps it into the first position, then finds 2.
3. Insertion sort grows a sorted prefix: insert 1 before 3, then insert 2 between them.
All three have quadratic worst-case time; insertion is useful on nearly sorted inputs.
